  "first_3_seconds": "Overhead shot of Catherine in a silk chemise curled against a bare-chested priest in bed, then a low-angle close-up of her looking down adoringly as she says, 'A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas.'",
  "ending": "Father Thomas, bare-chested with Catherine's hand over his heart, demands: 'The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office.'",
  "problems": [
    "The opening relies on a taboo visual (priest in bed) but the line is more playful than shocking; it may not fully land for viewers who don't immediately register the collar.",
    "The transactional turn ('Name your price' / 'west territory') is abrupt and may confuse viewers who were expecting a purely romantic or forbidden-love dynamic.",
    "The clip assumes the viewer understands the power dynamics and stakes of 'west territory' without any prior context."
  ],
